yarn.meaning: Every fact survives: the 227-year-old hemlock planted in 1791, "gusts reportedly up to 70 mph (about 110 km/h)", the whisky barrel, "no relation to the 42nd President Bill Clinton", Jackson's magnolia and the Pioneer Cabin sequoia.
yarn.sense: The few changes fit: "knocked over on Friday by gusts", "Other historic US trees to come down lately", "km/h" for the Australian unit.
yarn.authenticity: What it says is natural Australian news English ("the people running the Mount Vernon estate", "no relation to"), but almost nothing in it is distinctively Australian.
yarn.register: Far lighter than level 3: it is a plain-English rewrite with hardly a local word, such as "Mount Vernon was Washington's own estate, where he worked through most of his two terms".
yarn.tone: Keeps the straight news tone: "According to Mount Vernon officials, the hemlock is the best documented tree on the estate."
yarn.flow: Reads smoothly, the original's awkward first sentence untangled: "on Mount Vernon, the Virginia estate of the first US President George Washington".
yarn.variety: Too little slang to vary; nothing is repeated either.

unharnessed.meaning: Every fact survives: "taken out a 227-year-old tree at Mount Vernon", the 1791 planting, the 70 mph gusts, the whisky barrel gift, the Vice Presidency 1805–1812, the other fallen trees.
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "has taken out a 227-year-old tree", "got knocked over", "no relation to the 42nd President", "to come down lately".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural, the way an Australian reporter talking would put it: "the hemlock's the best documented tree on the estate", "where he ran most of his two terms".
unharnessed.register: Light, a little Aussie in the verbs and contractions, but lighter than level 3 asks: "According to Mount Vernon officials" and most lines stay plain.
unharnessed.tone: Keeps the news tone with a conversational lift: "famous for the car-sized tunnel cut through its trunk".
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "sent as a gift by New York Governor George Clinton and delivered in a whisky barrel".
unharnessed.variety: Few slang terms to vary, none repeated.
